episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. transcript_window.text: It's fascinating because if they didn't have other humans around them, they just would have never known that sight was a thing.
If we, as other humans, didn't tell them, they just couldn't see.
And so it is like, is there a sense that we might not be aware of that?
A bunch of them, I bet.
Yeah.
I don't know.
But that is an interesting thought experiment.
Because to those people, it was actually a random memory I just got, too.
We also did a video where we helped 1 ,000 deaf people here again.
And a lot of them, it was just giving them like really, really advanced hearing aids.
And they just hadn't heard in years.
And there's this one scene we did where a guy had a newborn child that was like a couple years old.
But it was deaf since the child was born and had never heard his child.
And so we put it in and it like really, really amplified sound where he could actually hear.
He hadn't heard sound in God knows how long.
And then the first thing he heard is we had his child just say daddy.
And he like lost it.
That was the first word he heard in years.
And it was the first time he ever heard her.
I don't even know why that memory popped in my head.
That's incredible.
That was like one of the most special things we've ever filmed was like that moment right there.
I was like, wow, that's crazy.
Yeah, we assume that the senses that we have detect everything that's around us.
But we know that's really not true because they're so limited just in terms of our ability to see things, right?
We see more things with microscope than you can with the naked eye.
